mapper.sql: SELECT ta.attachment_id, 'TENDER' AS business_type, ta.tender_id AS business_id, t.tender_name AS business_name, ta.file_type, NULL AS file_category, ta.file_name, ta.file_path, ta.file_size, SUBSTRING_INDEX(ta.file_name, '.', -1) AS file_format, NULL AS file_md5, ta.version_no, 1 AS is_latest, ta.upload_user_id, ta.upload_time, 0 AS download_count, NULL AS last_download_time, '正常' AS file_status, '内部' AS security_level, ta.upload_user_id AS created_by, NULL AS created_dept_id, NULL AS created_post_id, ta.upload_time AS created_time, ta.upload_time AS updated_time, ta.remark FROM exp_tender_attachment ta LEFT JOIN exp_tender t ON ta.tender_id = t.tender_id UNION ALL SELECT ba.attachment_id, 'BID' AS business_type, ba.bid_id AS business_id, b.bid_name AS business_name, ba.file_type, NULL AS file_category, ba.file_name, ba.file_path, ba.file_size, SUBSTRING_INDEX(ba.file_name, '.', -1) AS file_format, NULL AS file_md5, ba.version_no, 1 AS is_latest, ba.upload_user_id, ba.upload_time, 0 AS download_count, NULL AS last_download_time, '正常' AS file_status, '内部' AS security_level, ba.upload_user_id AS created_by, NULL AS created_dept_id, NULL AS created_post_id, ba.upload_time AS created_time, ba.upload_time AS updated_time, ba.remark FROM exp_bid_attachment ba LEFT JOIN exp_bid b ON ba.bid_id = b.bid_id
